results.title: Ferryman
results.overview: The year is 2022. Russian ferryman Konstantinich lives in a village in Zaporizhzhia. After the collapse of the USSR, the old bridge across the Azov estuary was destroyed and dismantled for scrap metal, and Konstantinich began ferrying people. He connects the two banks and takes responsibility for everything that happens in his native land.

results.title: Quicksand
results.overview: Cecilia embarks on a challenging new chapter, balancing the roles of both partner and carer for her husband, Albert, who is living with young-onset Alzheimer’s disease.

results.title: Tomorrow’s a New Day
results.overview: Suffocated by the constant stimuli of everyday life, Mar decides to travel to her grandparents' village in northern Portugal. Upon arriving, she finds Amparo and feelings start to develop as they find comfort in their differences. A story that explores the insatiable and constant search for purpose.

results.title: Hellenius hörna hyllar musik
results.overview: Måns Zelmerlöw, Fröken Snusk and Orup, together with more music profiles, explore why certain songs and genres become timeless and what it takes to create the perfect hit song.

results.title: Vilaayath Budha
results.overview: In the secluded hills of Marayur, a region steeped in the scent and lore of sandalwood, Vilayath Buddha unfolds as a potent character drama anchored in pride, memory, and resistance.

results.title: That Night
results.overview: Told through striking animation, one woman’s powerful account of surviving a fire in Tehran’s Evin prison captures resistance; an urgent, creative act rooted in the Iranian Woman! Life! Freedom! movement.

results.title: Closing Act
results.overview: Faced with the departure of her roommate, the kind but stubborn Julia must adjust to a life of her own. Realizing that moving on means losing more than just objects, Julia embarks on a nostalgic journey of self-discovery.

results.title: Second Guessing Fate
results.overview: Gemma has given up on dating until a fortune teller predicts she's one last horrible date away from true love. When she goes on a date with Nick, anything and everything goes wrong, including crashing her car into a handsome and wealthy stranger.

results.title: The Weatherman Who Knew Too Much
results.original_title: The Weatherman Who Knew Too Much
results.overview: Desperate to keep his job, a local weatherman seeks out prediction powers from a psychic, but will the power of his new abilities be his downfall or will he be able to keep up the charade?

results.title: Everyone at My Place for New Year's Eve
results.overview: On New Year's Eve, everyone at Minister Colombo's house! And what could go wrong? Practically everything, because of a "paragnost" magician.

During the World Cup final between Argentina and Holland, in times of military dictatorship, a group of torturers kidnap a group of young people. What begins as an inhumane interrogation turns into hell: the wrong group has been kidnapped.

results.title: Grief
results.overview: Kira (21) is a girl who was forced to abort her pregnancy by her lover and his family. Not accepting this, Kira tried to fight back, but unexpectedly a robbery incident caused her to lose her life. Her best friend who knew about Kira's incident tried to seek justice.

results.title: Amérique Latine, un continent sous influences
results.original_title: Amérique Latine, un continent sous influences

results.title: The Juggler
results.overview: Villeneuve-Lès-Maguelone, South France. Saturday morning. Raoul, a young teenager, is waiting for Serge, with whom he is to spend the weekend. Torn between his impatience to reconnect with this man he knows so little about and his contempt for this atypical, crazy father, temporarily out of prison, Raoul must find his way during a road trip through the shallows of his childhood ponds.

results.title: A SHOT IN THE FOOT
results.overview: A SHOT IN THE FOOT depects hectic nocturnal routines of a young woman who works as an assassin. She is a quick and innovative killer, efficient at her job. But she grows careless as she parties hard and gives in to the thrill of money, exposing herself to the dangers of LA’s underground. She gets sloppy, but the jobs keep coming, and there is no one except herself to clean up the mess she leaves behind.

results.title: Box
results.overview: A man—Eric, playing a version of himself—embarks on a quiet but obsessive quest to discover what lies inside a bag.

results.title: Musical Revue 『TARKIE ~ Legendary Women ~』
results.original_title: ミュージカルレビュー『TARKIE～伝説の女たち』
results.overview: A musical based on the life of Takiko Mizunoe, featuring Takarazuka OG Ouki Kaname.

results.title: ACA 188: Gadzhiev vs. Pshukov
results.overview: ACA 188: Gadzhiev vs. Pshukov was a mixed martial arts event that took place on Saturday, June 28, 2025 at the Bolshoy Ice Dome in Sochi, Russia.

results.title: Tomorrow Remains Unknown
results.original_title: Eingin veit á morgni at siga
results.overview: Tomorrow Remains Unknown follows 18-year-old Bjørt through a  single day that quietly changes her life. Living with her mother and younger brother, she struggles  between teenage freedom and the weight of responsibility.
